verification_note: Every url re-opened with the kit's fetcher. All 28 findings confirmed. Corrected: Brett Hightower's office source no longer cites a WBKO report (not re-opened; the Sheriff's Office page alone states the office); Scott Alexander's 1996 past_party wording cut to the general election, which is what the Wikipedia table shows with the Democratic label.
note: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after six searches for this part, so the rest was read directly from county, city, school district and State Board of Elections pages with the kit's fetcher. Many hosts did not resolve or refused the connection (casey, hickman, rockcastle, taylor, floyd, harlan and knott county sites on ky.gov, Shelbyville's and Jeffersontown's city sites, perrycounty.ky.gov answered 502). The State Board's 2022 general election recaps were read where they carry text (Boyd, Monroe, Nicholas, Warren); those of Perry, Butler, Casey, Cumberland, Floyd, Graves, Harlan, Hickman, Knott, Leslie and Taylor are scans, and Ballard's and Rockcastle's addresses answered 404. Checked and not holding the office sought: Denise Tarrance (Butler County's clerk page names another clerk; she is listed among the office's staff, not recorded), Cara Ann Walker (McCracken County's clerk page names another clerk), Matt Thresher (not among Ballard County's magistrates), Daniel Sizemore (not on Leslie County's officials page), Joshua Henderson (not among Butler County Schools' board members), Kristi Castillo (not among the judges on the Court of Justice's Marshall County page). No party page in this slice says it endorses a candidate; the county party lines already kept in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json are support lists. Danny Carroll and Sarah Stalker are sitting legislators with record pages; neither filing page lists a website, and only Stalker's campaign site was found.
